state_semantics.skill_state: Per-concept latent knowledge vector. This is not directly user-facing mastery.
state_semantics.all_state: Global student latent state used by MIKT prediction/update.
state_semantics.last_skill_time: Per-concept last update step for elapsed-step forgetting.

tap_seen_count.semantics: Per-concept number of completed learner responses. Used to distinguish unseen concepts and compute log1p(seen_count).

tap_recent_correct_rate.semantics: Per-concept correctness mean over the most recent responses. The app maintains a small response ring buffer and passes the derived rate to TAP.
